testes.nota: 'opens on click' failed on the first try — probed reka-ui's ComboboxRoot directly and found the listbox only opens once you start typing, not on a bare click/focus of the input (aria-expanded stayed 'false' after click, became 'true' after the first keystroke). Rewrote every scenario around typing to open, instead of assuming Select-like click-to-open semantics.

residuos_shadcn_removidos: FOURTH cn-* broken-class instance: cn-menu-translucent on ComboboxList (same family as DropdownMenuContent/SelectContent/Round 1's Dialog)
outline-hidden (appears throughout the shadcn preset, not a real accessibility improvement over outline-none in this context) -> outline-none, consistent with how it was handled elsewhere

REAL INCIDENT, not just a leftover: running `add` with -o (--overwrite, required because combobox declares button/input as registryDependencies) reset our already-retokenized button/index.ts and input/Input.vue back to raw shadcn defaults on the first attempt — caught immediately via git status and restored via git checkout before any further work; documented in the raw commit and in the README
the CLI also pulled in a whole unrelated `textarea` component (1 file, 28 lines) as an incidental registry dependency — not referenced anywhere in combobox's own code, left completely untouched

an unused InputGroupButton.vue (part of input-group, not used by Combobox) broke the build after this trim: its variant default was 'ghost', a Button variant removed in Round 1 — fixed the default to 'secondary' just to keep the project compiling, since it's dead code otherwise
